name: 创新（智能/无人/高效）研发

map.⚙️ 智能、无人与高效对比计算器: ⚙️ Intelligent, Unmanned and High-Efficiency Comparison Calculator
map.分别输入智能、无人化、高效三项 0–100 评分（评分口径自定义），对比权重占比: Score the intelligent, unmanned and high-efficiency routes on a 0–100 scale, then compare their weights and the leading route.
map.📖 查看「智能、无人与高效对比计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Intelligent, Unmanned and High-Efficiency Comparison Calculator Guide"
map.综合差距 = 最高评分 − 最低评分；路线权重占比 = 该路线评分 ÷ 三项评分: Composite gap = highest score − lowest score; route weight = that route's score ÷ the sum of the three scores × 100%; recommendation = the highest-scoring route (all listed on a tie). Validation: each score must be a number from 0 to 100 and the three scores must not all be zero, otherwise the fields are flagged and the calculation stops.
map.三项评分分别反映智能化、无人化与高效化程度，评分口径由使用者自定义（如按功能覆盖: The three scores reflect the degree of intelligence, unmanned operation and efficiency. You define the scoring basis (for example functionality coverage, labour substitution rate, output/energy ratio). The weights quantify how R&D resources would be split across the three routes.
map.💡 综合差距 = 最高评分 − 最低评分；路线权重占比 = 该路线评分 ÷ 三项: 💡 Composite gap = highest score − lowest score; route weight = that route's score ÷ the sum of the three scores. You define the scoring basis.
map.研发方案按智能、无人化、高效三条路线分别打分（0–100）。: Score an R&D plan on the intelligent, unmanned and high-efficiency routes (0–100 each).
map.按权重占比分配研发资源与预算。: Allocate R&D resources and budget by weight.
map.比较不同方案的领先路线与评分差距。: Compare the leading route and score gap across plans.
map.智能 90、高效 70、无人化 95：合计 255，权重分别为 35.3%、27: Intelligent 90, high-efficiency 70, unmanned 95: total 255, weights 35.3% / 27.5% / 37.3%; composite gap = 95 − 70 = 25, so the unmanned route leads.
map.三项评分须使用同一口径与量纲，例如均按「功能覆盖 40% + 人工替代 30%: Use the same basis and scale for all three scores, for example 40% functionality coverage + 30% labour substitution + 30% input-output; scores from different bases are not directly comparable.
map.评分相同怎么办？: What if two scores are equal?
map.并列最高时页面会同时列出并标注「路线优先」，此时需结合投入、风险与实施周期另行决: When routes tie for the highest score the page lists them all as leading; decide using investment, risk and implementation time, or re-score with different indicator weights.
map.评分能代替可行性论证？: Can scores replace a feasibility study?
map.不能。评分是主观量化的排序工具，权重与口径会显著影响结论，关键决策仍需成本测算、: No. Scoring is a subjective ranking aid; weights and basis strongly affect the result, so key decisions still need cost estimates, technical validation and risk assessment.
map.创新（智能/无人/高效）研发。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全: An innovation (intelligent/unmanned/high-efficiency) R&D calculator. Free online tool, processed entirely on the client side; data is not uploaded, protecting your privacy.
map.针对研发方案输入各项参数，量化对比智能、无人化与高效化路线的指标差异，辅助创新研: Enter R&D plan parameters to quantify differences among intelligent, unmanned, and high-efficiency routes, supporting innovation decisions.
